[{"id":"nnvMTG5Sl5","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"🫂Ministries Manual","col":12}},{"id":"B-CtTCmVDX","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The ministries module contains features related to functions and specific ministries of the church.","col":12}},{"id":"w8oEjl0tNc","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"🗓️Functions","col":12}},{"id":"riOh9J0you","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Church functions are used to track attendance and for linking to other documents.","col":12}},{"id":"6k3AeERCdQ","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When creating a function, note the following:
- Default function types are provided, but additional function types can be created.
    - When creating a function type, you can choose an existing function as a 'template function'. This will allow you to click the 'Fill From Template' button when creating this type of function in the future to fill in most of the function details using the template function's values.
- Other documents can be linked as items in the function's schedule (i.e. Songs, Sermons, People, Bible References, etc)
- Attendance can be tracked (Additional attendance types can be added if needed)
    - To pre-populate attendance for a function, you can select a 'template function' in the related function type. Then clicking the 'Fill From Template' button will pre-populate all attendance records from the template function.","col":12}},{"id":"_0iXv3IWcn","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"The Ministries workspace includes links to function and attendance reports.","col":12}},{"id":"bLMhfdXsV3","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"🎵Songs","col":12}},{"id":"7ts41_VmsH","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Songs can be added as items to a church function.
Note: there is not currently a way to present a song. This is planned in future versions.","col":12}},{"id":"ljVNwCikn3","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When creating a song, note the following:
- If you know the CCLI number for the song, you can add it. This may be used in future enhancements.
- You can add any number of slides to a song.
- After creating a song, you may want to add it to a function's schedule.","col":12}}]
